title: OfficeCharter
description: Schema for registry/personas/offices/<office>/charter.yaml. Sibling to persona-card.schema.json (registry/personas/persona-card.schema.json), which this schema extends conceptually (an office wraps a PersonaCard with authority/escalation) rather than duplicating any of its fields. Validated the same way persona cards are: `python3 -c "import json,yaml,jsonschema; jsonschema.validate(yaml.safe_load(open('registry/personas/offices/cfo/charter.yaml')), json.load(open('registry/personas/offices/office-charter.schema.json')))"`. Full wiring into registry/personas/registry.py's CLI (as a new `validate-office` subcommand) is a follow-up — this schema is authored and usable standalone today; not yet invoked from registry.py per the task's own scope caution against ad-hoc changes to a tested loader without an accompanying test.
